- Media notification: a YouTube Music or Spotify song shows its own cover instead of the radio picture.
- YouTube Music and Spotify: when the picked list runs out, the queue goes on with songs like the one that was picked (a mix of its artist).
- Keyboard emoji page: the space bar is unseen until pressed, and the delete key stands higher (its foot level with the top of the space bar).
- Keyboard: an empty box offers the e-mail address used most in the left slot (held: all the saved addresses), the sentence words in the middle and right.
- Pulse's icon has a lighter blue ground.
- Look wallpapers: decoded at their own size (no fixed half-size decode), so they are sharp on a tablet in landscape.
- Widgets: a tap outside the widget being edited ends the editing.
- Files: Move to Secure Folder (Samsung, user 150): the file goes to the same folder there (root, or Shizuku with access).
- YTXTube: the Music tab is off by default (songs play in Pulse's music player); Settings brings it back.
- Code: the code editor is an app of its own (launcher entry, Extra apps menu): an AMOLED black page with the files opened lately, Open and New; the editor is AMOLED black by default (a chip gives the look's colour back), its tools are always in view (no ⋮), and a page (html, svg) has a Run button that shows it as a browser does; html and markdown files open in it from Files with a tap.
- Tablets: This PC is drawn as a device lying on its side (wide) on the desktop, the taskbar and Explorer.
- Tablets: the desktop icons are drawn a third bigger (they were tiny between wide gaps).
- Launcher: a mouse's right button on a desktop icon opens its menu at once.
- Music, YouTube Music page: the playlists on top are a speed dial of square covers with no title under them.
- Windows desktops: an app's shortcut wears the small shortcut arrow in its corner.
- Windows 11 File Explorer: Devices and drives on the first page (the storage with its bar of used space and what is free).
- Keyboard calculator: the answer of a sum before the cursor comes up in the middle of the bar at once (no = needed) and a tap writes it the way the sum is written (12*5=60, 12 * 5 = 60); small raised digits are powers (2⁶ = 64); dates and phone numbers are not taken for sums; the Calculator tile with nothing to work out opens the numbers page.
- Keyboard: a screenshot or file waiting in the right slot stays there while a word is typed, until it is pasted once or its time runs out.
- Keyboard Dictionary: a Turkish word gets its meanings from the Turkish Language Association's dictionary (TDK) first, in Turkish; a mistyped word is looked up by its right form.
- Keyboard settings: the theme pictures are the real keyboard in small (three rows of lettered keys, shift and delete in the special colour, the action key in the accent).
- Sticky note widget: a tap opens the note itself over the home screen, where the widget is, to write on at once (Windows 7 style; saved as it is typed, a tap beside it puts it back, the full editor is one button away, a dot changes its colour); the note stands a little tilted like a paper note, and the widget can be made smaller.
